recent_announcements.body:
Squad leads and the platoon staff meet in Command one hour before step-off.

Bring your own map markers. Radio matrix will be published in the field manual the morning of.
recent_announcements.snippet: Squad leads in Command at 20:00Z Friday. Radio matrix published the morning of.
recent_announcements.title: OP BYTE PARITY — orders group Friday 20:00Z

recent_announcements.body:
The Core Modern Expansion has been bumped to **2.1**.

Re-sync before Saturday's operation — the server will reject 2.0 clients at the loading screen. Total download is roughly 45 GB; the delta from 2.0 is about 3 GB.

If your launcher stalls, clear `%LOCALAPPDATA%/Arma Reforger/addons` and re-subscribe.
recent_announcements.snippet: Core Modern Expansion 2.1 is live. Re-sync before Saturday or the server will reject your client.
recent_announcements.title: Modpack 2.1 is mandatory from Saturday

recent_announcements.body: Primary goes down for roughly forty minutes for a host kernel update. Secondary stays up for anyone who wants to keep flying.
